entries.source_note: Sarkar: Ka is the acoustic root of the abhīpsātmaka āśā vrtti (hope).
entries.binding_expression: hope as grasping / clinging to a specific outcome
entries.liberating_expression: forward-orientation held without attachment to the outcome
entries.functional_operation: aspires and acts while releasing the grip on the result
entries.contrast_boundary: not object-renunciation (Gha), not craving-cessation (Dha), not de-fascination (Na)
entries.binding_bridge: hope as grasping / clinging to a specific outcome
entries.liberating_bridge: forward-orientation held without attachment to the outcome — aspires and acts while releasing the grip on the result

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of cintā vrtti (worry / impersonal, objective thought).
entries.binding_expression: anxious impersonal rumination over open contingencies
entries.liberating_expression: composed openness within unresolved impersonal uncertainty
entries.functional_operation: holds an unsettled impersonal situation open without forcing premature closure
entries.contrast_boundary: not self-efficacy (Ya), not threat-steadiness (Pha), not firmness-under-strain (Cha)
entries.binding_bridge: anxious impersonal rumination over open contingencies
entries.liberating_bridge: composed openness within unresolved impersonal uncertainty — holds an unsettled impersonal situation open without forcing premature closure

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of ceṣṭā vrtti (effort to arouse dormant potential).
entries.binding_expression: striving driven by restlessness that cannot stop
entries.liberating_expression: effort that can rest — poised, alert stillness when action completes
entries.functional_operation: exerts, then ceases into stable alert repose without inertia
entries.contrast_boundary: not dull inertia (Ta), not outcome-release (Ka), not containment (Ma)
entries.binding_bridge: striving driven by restlessness that cannot stop
entries.liberating_bridge: effort that can rest — poised, alert stillness when action completes — exerts, then ceases into stable alert repose without inertia

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of mamatā (love/attachment bound by time, space, individuality).
entries.binding_expression: love owned as possession and mine-ness
entries.liberating_expression: care that holds the loved on an open hand
entries.functional_operation: loves while relinquishing ownership of the object
entries.contrast_boundary: not outcome-release (Ka), not thirst-cessation (Dha), not indifference (Ba)
entries.binding_bridge: love owned as possession and mine-ness
entries.liberating_bridge: care that holds the loved on an open hand — loves while relinquishing ownership of the object

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of dambha vrtti (vanity).
entries.binding_expression: self displayed and performed for others' eyes
entries.liberating_expression: conduct that stands without outward performance
entries.functional_operation: acts without staging the self for approval
entries.contrast_boundary: not inner I-claim deflation (Ja), not inner/outer honesty (Ña)
entries.binding_bridge: self displayed and performed for others' eyes
entries.liberating_bridge: conduct that stands without outward performance — acts without staging the self for approval

source_attested_pole.english_rendering: Discernment (real vs unreal, right vs wrong)

entries.source_note: Sarkar: Ca is the acoustic root of viveka (conscience/discrimination); the discerning capacity is source-attested.
entries.binding_expression: discernment hardening into judgment / separation-pride
entries.liberating_expression: falsehood-discerning insight without egoic superiority
entries.functional_operation: separates truth from falsehood by detecting misperception, distortion, and false appearance
entries.contrast_boundary: not Va/dharma, not assent, not acceptance-as-true, not conduct-ordering
entries.binding_bridge: discernment hardening into judgment / separation-pride
entries.liberating_bridge: falsehood-discerning insight without egoic superiority — separates truth from falsehood by detecting misperception, distortion, and false appearance

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of vikalatā vrtti (nervous breakdown).
entries.binding_expression: collapse of mental function under strain
entries.liberating_expression: steadiness that keeps function intact under load
entries.functional_operation: holds the mind operational under a load that would otherwise break it
entries.contrast_boundary: not threat-steadiness (Pha), not forbearance (Da), not poised rest (Ga)
entries.binding_bridge: collapse of mental function under strain
entries.liberating_bridge: steadiness that keeps function intact under load — holds the mind operational under a load that would otherwise break it

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of ahaṁkāra vrtti (ego / inflated I-feeling).
entries.binding_expression: the inflated 'I did / I control this'
entries.liberating_expression: agency exercised without inflating the I
entries.functional_operation: acts while withdrawing the inflated I-claim from the account of events
entries.contrast_boundary: not outward display-dropping (Ṅa), not inner/outer honesty (Ña)
entries.binding_bridge: the inflated 'I did / I control this'
entries.liberating_bridge: agency exercised without inflating the I — acts while withdrawing the inflated I-claim from the account of events

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of lolupatā, lobha (greed) and lolatā (avarice).
entries.binding_expression: hoarding accumulation without limit
entries.liberating_expression: sufficiency — appetite that releases at enough
entries.functional_operation: stops accumulation at sufficiency and releases the surplus grip
entries.contrast_boundary: not thirst-cessation (Dha), not non-possessive love (Gha), not outcome-release (Ka)
entries.binding_bridge: hoarding accumulation without limit
entries.liberating_bridge: sufficiency — appetite that releases at enough — stops accumulation at sufficiency and releases the surplus grip

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of kapaṭatā vrtti (hypocrisy).
entries.binding_expression: concealment — inner and outer diverging
entries.liberating_expression: transparency — inner intent and outer act coincide
entries.functional_operation: aligns inner intent with outer act, removing concealment
entries.contrast_boundary: not display-dropping (Ṅa), not I-claim deflation (Ja)
entries.binding_bridge: concealment — inner and outer diverging
entries.liberating_bridge: transparency — inner intent and outer act coincide — aligns inner intent with outer act, removing concealment

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of vitarka vrtti (overstating one's case).
entries.binding_expression: garrulous exaggeration beyond the warranted
entries.liberating_expression: measured speech saying only what is warranted
entries.functional_operation: trims expression to exactly the warranted amount
entries.contrast_boundary: not honesty of intent (Ña), not containment (Ma), not poised rest (Ga)
entries.binding_bridge: garrulous exaggeration beyond the warranted
entries.liberating_bridge: measured speech saying only what is warranted — trims expression to exactly the warranted amount

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of anutāpa vrtti (repentance).
entries.binding_expression: remorse that grips and repeats over one's own past act
entries.liberating_expression: self-directed release of remorse into acceptance
entries.functional_operation: discharges remorse over one's own past act into acceptance
entries.contrast_boundary: not other-directed forbearance (Da), not shame-release (Ḍa)
entries.binding_bridge: remorse that grips and repeats over one's own past act
entries.liberating_bridge: self-directed release of remorse into acceptance — discharges remorse over one's own past act into acceptance

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of lajjā vrtti (shyness).
entries.binding_expression: action inhibited by others' regard
entries.liberating_expression: acting unhindered by social shame
entries.functional_operation: releases the inhibiting grip of others' regard on action
entries.contrast_boundary: not threat-steadiness (Pha), not remorse-release (Ṭha)
entries.binding_bridge: action inhibited by others' regard
entries.liberating_bridge: acting unhindered by social shame — releases the inhibiting grip of others' regard on action

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of piśunatā (senseless / sadistic cruelty).
entries.binding_expression: malice — sadistic cruelty toward the maligned
entries.liberating_expression: compassion that shields the maligned
entries.functional_operation: turns malice-energy toward protecting the maligned (social harm)
entries.contrast_boundary: not protection of the physically weak (La), not goodwill against revulsion (Pa)
entries.binding_bridge: malice — sadistic cruelty toward the maligned
entries.liberating_bridge: compassion that shields the maligned — turns malice-energy toward protecting the maligned (social harm)

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of īrṣyā vrtti (envy).
entries.binding_expression: the sting at another's success
entries.liberating_expression: sympathetic gladness at another's fortune
entries.functional_operation: converts the sting at another's fortune into shared gladness
entries.contrast_boundary: not goodwill against revulsion (Pa), not compassion for suffering (Ḍha/La)
entries.binding_bridge: the sting at another's success
entries.liberating_bridge: sympathetic gladness at another's fortune — converts the sting at another's fortune into shared gladness

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of staticity, long sleep and deep sleep.
entries.binding_expression: dullness, torpor, deep sleep of mind
entries.liberating_expression: alert wakefulness rising from torpor
entries.functional_operation: lifts dullness and sleep into active alertness
entries.contrast_boundary: not breaking an induced spell (Bha), not poised rest (Ga), not discernment (Ca)
entries.binding_bridge: dullness, torpor, deep sleep of mind
entries.liberating_bridge: alert wakefulness rising from torpor — lifts dullness and sleep into active alertness

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of viṣāda vrtti (melancholy).
entries.binding_expression: dejection that sinks one's own mood
entries.liberating_expression: warm buoyancy lifting one's own dejection
entries.functional_operation: raises one's own dejection into affectionate uplift
entries.contrast_boundary: not gladness at others' good (Ṇa), not goodwill toward others (Pa)
entries.binding_bridge: dejection that sinks one's own mood
entries.liberating_bridge: warm buoyancy lifting one's own dejection — raises one's own dejection into affectionate uplift

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of peevishness (krodha / karkaśatā).
entries.binding_expression: reactive irritability discharged at others
entries.liberating_expression: forbearance that absorbs provocation
entries.functional_operation: absorbs present provocation from another without discharging it back
entries.contrast_boundary: not self-remorse-release (Ṭha), not shame-release (Ḍa), not poised rest (Ga)
entries.binding_bridge: reactive irritability discharged at others
entries.liberating_bridge: forbearance that absorbs provocation — absorbs present provocation from another without discharging it back

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of thirst for acquisition (tṛṣṇā).
entries.binding_expression: limitless thirst to acquire
entries.liberating_expression: the acquisitive thirst quenched at its root
entries.functional_operation: extinguishes the thirst-to-acquire itself, not merely one object
entries.contrast_boundary: not outcome-release (Ka), not object non-possession (Gha), not anti-hoarding (Jha)
entries.binding_bridge: limitless thirst to acquire
entries.liberating_bridge: the acquisitive thirst quenched at its root — extinguishes the thirst-to-acquire itself, not merely one object

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of moha vrtti (blind attachment / infatuation).
entries.binding_expression: infatuation that fixates on a compulsive attraction
entries.liberating_expression: de-fascination from false attraction
entries.functional_operation: breaks the spell of blind attachment by making the attractive object lose compulsive grip
entries.contrast_boundary: not Ca/Viveka, not general clarity, not renunciation, not disgust
entries.binding_bridge: infatuation that fixates on a compulsive attraction
entries.liberating_bridge: de-fascination from false attraction — breaks the spell of blind attachment by making the attractive object lose compulsive grip

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of ghṛṇā vrtti (hatred / revulsion).
entries.binding_expression: revulsion turned against another
entries.liberating_expression: goodwill that dissolves revulsion
entries.functional_operation: converts revulsion toward another into active goodwill
entries.contrast_boundary: not compassion for the suffering (Ḍha/La), not gladness at fortune (Ṇa)
entries.binding_bridge: revulsion turned against another
entries.liberating_bridge: goodwill that dissolves revulsion — converts revulsion toward another into active goodwill

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of bhaya vrtti (fear).
entries.binding_expression: collapse or flight before danger
entries.liberating_expression: steadiness meeting a genuine threat
entries.functional_operation: meets a real danger without collapse or flight
entries.contrast_boundary: not social-shame release (Ḍa), not composure under uncertainty (Kha), not firmness-under-strain (Cha)
entries.binding_bridge: collapse or flight before danger
entries.liberating_bridge: steadiness meeting a genuine threat — meets a real danger without collapse or flight

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of avajñā vrtti (indifference / neglect of the valuable).
entries.binding_expression: neglect of what actually has value
entries.liberating_expression: regard that recognizes and attends to worth
entries.functional_operation: attends to and honors what has real value instead of neglecting it
entries.contrast_boundary: not goodwill against revulsion (Pa), not gladness at fortune (Ṇa)
entries.binding_bridge: neglect of what actually has value
entries.liberating_bridge: regard that recognizes and attends to worth — attends to and honors what has real value instead of neglecting it

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of mūrcchā vrtti (loss of common sense under a ripu's hypnotic spell).
entries.binding_expression: hypnotic entrancement, loss of common sense
entries.liberating_expression: breaking the entrancing spell into clear sense
entries.functional_operation: snaps an externally-induced hypnotic fixation and restores clear common sense
entries.contrast_boundary: not lifting dullness/sleep (Ta), not self-generated de-fascination (Na), not discernment (Ca)
entries.binding_bridge: hypnotic entrancement, loss of common sense
entries.liberating_bridge: breaking the entrancing spell into clear sense — snaps an externally-induced hypnotic fixation and restores clear common sense

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of praṇāśa (annihilation) and praśraya vrtti (giving latitude / indulgence).
entries.binding_expression: giving latitude to the point of dissolution
entries.liberating_expression: disciplined containment that holds form
entries.functional_operation: contains and holds a form against over-indulgence and dissolution
entries.contrast_boundary: not measured speech (Ṭa), not forbearance (Da), not poised rest (Ga)
entries.binding_bridge: giving latitude to the point of dissolution
entries.liberating_bridge: disciplined containment that holds form — contains and holds a form against over-indulgence and dissolution

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of aviśvāsa vrtti (lack of confidence in oneself and others).
entries.binding_expression: self-doubt that cannot commit
entries.liberating_expression: self-efficacy to commit and to rely
entries.functional_operation: musters the self-trust needed to commit to an action
entries.contrast_boundary: not composure under impersonal uncertainty (Kha), not threat-steadiness (Pha)
entries.binding_bridge: self-doubt that cannot commit
entries.liberating_bridge: self-efficacy to commit and to rely — musters the self-trust needed to commit to an action

source_attested_pole.english_rendering: vitality / creative fire AND destructive-collapse tendency

entries.source_note: Sarkar (dual attestation): Ra = acoustic root of agnitattva/prāṇaśakti (vitality) AND of sarvanāśa (destructive collapse; the 'everything is lost / I am undone' tendency). Both classically attested; Sarvanāśa folded into the binding expression, kept visible for traceability — not dropped.
entries.binding_expression: rajasic activation driven by compulsion, desire, projection, or destructive collapse
entries.liberating_expression: directed energy without bondage
entries.functional_operation: converts force into non-compulsive action
entries.contrast_boundary: not mere vitality, not suppression, not passive calm, not destructive sarvanāśa-collapse
entries.binding_bridge: rajasic activation driven by compulsion, desire, projection, or destructive collapse
entries.liberating_bridge: directed energy without bondage — converts force into non-compulsive action

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of krūratā vrtti (cruelty), countered by compassion.
entries.binding_expression: physical harm inflicted on the weak
entries.liberating_expression: compassion that protects the physically vulnerable
entries.functional_operation: turns harming-energy toward protecting the physically weak
entries.contrast_boundary: not shielding the maligned from slander (Ḍha), not goodwill against revulsion (Pa)
entries.binding_bridge: physical harm inflicted on the weak
entries.liberating_bridge: compassion that protects the physically vulnerable — turns harming-energy toward protecting the physically weak

entries.source_note: Sarkar: Va is the acoustic root of dharma (ensconcement in one's sustaining stance); source-attested.
entries.binding_expression: accepting-as-true without sufficient discernment
entries.liberating_expression: truth-assent purified by discernment, installing only what is non-bindingly recognized
entries.functional_operation: accepts-as-true and organizes conduct around what is granted reality/order status
entries.contrast_boundary: not Ca/viveka, not falsehood detection, not analysis, not verification
entries.binding_bridge: accepting-as-true without sufficient discernment
entries.liberating_bridge: truth-assent purified by discernment, installing only what is non-bindingly recognized — accepts-as-true and organizes conduct around what is granted reality/order status

entries.source_note: Sarkar: Śa = acoustic root of rajoguṇa (mutative principle) and artha (psychic / worldly longing). A neutral dynamic principle, not a virtue/vice.
entries.binding_expression: worldly purpose possessed as acquisition, status, or control
entries.liberating_expression: purposeful action without possessive bondage
entries.functional_operation: uses aim and worldly purpose without identity or ownership
entries.contrast_boundary: not greed/generosity pair, not anti-worldliness, not renunciation
entries.binding_bridge: worldly purpose possessed as acquisition, status, or control
entries.liberating_bridge: purposeful action without possessive bondage — uses aim and worldly purpose without identity or ownership

entries.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of tamoguṇa (static principle) and kāma (worldly / physical desire).
entries.binding_expression: sensory craving bound to inertia
entries.liberating_expression: raw desire transmuted into grounded, contained drive
entries.functional_operation: channels raw sensory desire into a grounded, contained drive
entries.contrast_boundary: not thirst-cessation (Dha), not anti-hoarding sufficiency (Jha), not non-possession (Gha)
entries.binding_bridge: sensory craving bound to inertia
entries.liberating_bridge: raw desire transmuted into grounded, contained drive — channels raw sensory desire into a grounded, contained drive

entries.source_note: Sarkar: Sa = acoustic root of mokṣa (unqualified liberation) and sattvaguṇa. Sattva is still a guṇa (binds); mokṣa is trans-guṇa. Do not equate sattva with liberation.
entries.binding_expression: sattvic clarity/order owned as purity, superiority, or attachment to harmony
entries.liberating_expression: clarity without attachment to clarity
entries.functional_operation: lets clarity function without identity, pride, or bondage to harmony
entries.contrast_boundary: not mokṣa as final endpoint, not tamas removal, not moral goodness
entries.binding_bridge: sattvic clarity/order owned as purity, superiority, or attachment to harmony
entries.liberating_bridge: clarity without attachment to clarity — lets clarity function without identity, pride, or bondage to harmony

entries.source_note: Sarkar: Ha = acoustic root of parā-vidyā (intuitional science). Knowledge binds unless realized.
entries.binding_expression: higher knowledge owned as spiritual identity or subtle pride
entries.liberating_expression: realized knowing without ownership
entries.functional_operation: lets knowledge dissolve identity instead of forming spiritual ego
entries.contrast_boundary: not information, not doctrine, not intellectual certainty
entries.binding_bridge: higher knowledge owned as spiritual identity or subtle pride
entries.liberating_bridge: realized knowing without ownership — lets knowledge dissolve identity instead of forming spiritual ego

entries.source_note: Sarkar: Kṣa = acoustic root of mundane knowledge / material science (aparā-vidyā). Binds unless realized.
entries.binding_expression: structured knowledge owned as control, dogma, or intellectual identity
entries.liberating_expression: instrumental knowledge released from possession
entries.functional_operation: uses knowledge as tool without becoming the knower-identity
entries.contrast_boundary: not parā-vidyā, not dogma replacement, not technical pride
entries.binding_bridge: structured knowledge owned as control, dogma, or intellectual identity
entries.liberating_bridge: instrumental knowledge released from possession — uses knowledge as tool without becoming the knower-identity
